== Title ==
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパー士官</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。同じ位置に配備するならスノートルーパーは配備コスト－1。自分の兵員／トルーパーはホスの同じ位置に向かってリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">スノートルーパーのエリート士官。帝国陸軍の士官の常として、反乱軍の戦法には精通している。歩兵とAT-ATを連係させる要として働く。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Snowtrooper Officer.

'''Lore''' — An elite Snowtrooper officer. Like other Imperial Army officers, he is well versed in Rebel tactics. He serves as the link between the infantry and the AT-ATs.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. Thereafter, may move anywhere. Snowtroopers deploy for 1 less at the same location. Your troopers may move as a react to the same Hoth location as the officer.

Both photographed Japanese faces print ability 1. The English original prints ability 2. Three asterisks precede the white-border title. The Japanese uses 位置 where the English says site.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-snowtrooperofficer.gif|Original English face]], [[Snowtrooper Officer]].</ref>
